objectives.title: Earn the flag
objectives.prompt: Pass both architecture tests with one payload; the service then prints the flag.
hints: Find instruction bytes that are harmless on one architecture and branch on the other.
The flag's own text points at the arm64 system call instruction.

steps.title: Identify the second architecture
steps.prompt: Besides x86-64, on which architecture must the payload run?

steps.title: Know the constraint
steps.prompt: Which class of bytes is the payload limited to?

steps.title: Know the size limit
steps.prompt: What is the maximum payload length in bytes?

steps.title: Name the technique
steps.prompt: What do you call code that is valid and meaningful on several architectures at once?
